reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their #north-random message. I said the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 10 June, not the date in this morning's #north-team post, and that I hadn't changed anything. A renewal date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so nothing here needed approval.

One thing my reply got wrong: I wrote "Noted," but I don't keep any record of my own that I could update. The correction exists only in that thread. I also left their original #north-team post alone, since they said no action was needed.
